Overview

Johor Bahru is a city in Johor with a population of 1,711,000. Malaysia’s southern gateway city, connected to Singapore by a causeway and a growing economic powerhouse. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
